_comment: Deployment contract shared by every network in onnx_variants. The variants agree on the observation layout, action space, q_default, action_scale, gains and rate, which is what lets the controller switch between them mid-stride on a single observation history. Network input/output widths are checked against these numbers at load time. Trained with safe_rl/tasks/manager_based/velocity (Rl-Velocity-Aliengo). Joint order is the Isaac 'locosim_joint_names' order, identical to ROBOTS['aliengo']['joint_names'] in rl_controller_config.py.

notes.normalization: The empirical observation normalizer is baked into the ONNX graph (Sub/Div on 'obs'), so raw observations must be fed.
notes.imu_lin_acc: Raw accelerometer reading (specific force) on the inference tick, not averaged. The networks were trained with safe_rl.sensors.ImuCfg.finite_difference = physics_step, which maps to 'specific_force' (control_step -> 'mean_specific_force', upstream -> 'isaac_lazy_finite_difference'). 'physics_dt' is unused by this kind and kept as provenance. A contract without imu_lin_acc_model is read as 'specific_force'.
notes.imu_projected_gravity: Unit gravity direction in base frame, b_R_w @ (0,0,-1); level base gives (0,0,-1).
notes.history: Each history block is oldest frame first, newest last, flattened as (history_length, width).
notes.actions: Raw (pre-scale) network outputs of the previous control steps; zeros before the first inference.
notes.onnx_variants: Actors sharing this observation/action contract, so the controller can switch between them without disturbing the history. 'normal' tracks the operator velocity command (Rl-Velocity-Aliengo); 'safe' is the stand-still recovery policy (Safe-Rl-Aliengo), trained at zero command with harsher reset poses, velocities and pushes. Feed 'safe' a zero command, the only one it ever saw.
